notes:
Account summary: Alaris SurgeWorks provides an omnichannel contact center orchestration layer used by retail and telco customers. Heavy exposure to seasonal spikes (holiday campaigns) and frequent incident bursts when external backends fail. Seeking a partner to guarantee reliability for agent-assist and automated ticket triage during peak periods.

Stakeholder quotes: "We can tolerate some cost increase during black-friday windows but cannot drop below 99.9% conversational availability; agent productivity drops immediately." — Head of Product.

Tech constraints / preferences: prefer Dedicated pools in us-east-1 for predictable throughput; must be able to failover to a private on-prem cluster in case of cloud region outage. Integration points: Genesys Cloud + Zendesk + internal orchestration (gRPC webhook). Okta SSO mandatory, AWS KMS for transcript encryption. 30-day retention for transcripts, audit logs for all tool-calls.

PoC ask: 2-week functional PoC + 48-hour synthetic spike (up to 3k concurrent live agent sessions) to validate batching/autoscale and fallback latency. Measure P95 response <200ms for agent-assist tokens under normal load; under spike target is <350ms with soft-fallback to distilled model. Need cost estimates for steady-state and peak windows.

Business drivers: reduce average handle time (AHT) by 20% with agent-assist; eliminate ticket backlog growth during marketing-driven peaks; reduce live-handoff rate via higher-quality summaries.

CRM-style notes: discovery 2024-11-05, tech deep-dive w/ Ravi 2024-11-12 (demo of routing + fallbacks), security questionnaire submitted 2024-11-20, infra deep-dive w/ infra team 2024-11-28, contract chat w/ procurement 2024-12-02. SE ran a short baseline load test 2024-12-06 (results: OK at 500 concurrency; latency spikes after 1.2k). Next: full spike run week of 2024-12-16.

Short-hand: POC scope = load + failover + billing model. Blockers = legal SOC2 artifacts, procurement timeline, on-prem connectivity test.
